name: blocky
title: Blocky
description: Blocky is a small DNS proxy that blocks ads and trackers from block lists and forwards the rest over DNS-over-HTTPS. It has no web page: everything is in App-Data/Blocky/config/config.yml, which deploys with one block list and two upstreams. Point your router or devices at this server's DNS port; set that port to 53 once nothing else on the host uses it.

variables.name: PORT_BLOCKY_DNS
variables.label: DNS port
variables.description: TCP and UDP. 5353 by default because many servers already have a resolver on 53; devices on your network can only use it as their DNS server on port 53

variables.name: PORT_BLOCKY_HTTP
variables.label: API port
variables.description: Host port of the API and the Prometheus metrics (/metrics)
